status: actual registered source schemas; no handlers executed

tools.name: anime_search
tools.description: Search anime titles through the pinned ani-cli provider. Show the actual matching titles and let the user select ambiguous seasons before playback.

tools.name: anime_episodes
tools.description: List currently available episode numbers for a previously selected anime title.

identifier.description: Exact title/season ID returned by anime_search.

tools.name: anime_play
tools.description: Open one episode in local mpv on the Hermes host. Only use when the user asks to play; this opens a window and plays audio. Resolves a fresh stream and resumes five seconds before saved progress by default. Linux only in this version.

identifier.description: Exact title/season ID returned by anime_search.

episode.description: Episode number as returned by anime_episodes.

tools.name: anime_status
tools.description: Report actual mpv playback state and saved position; a launched process is not yet confirmed playback.

session_id.description: Playback session ID returned by anime_play or anime_resume.

tools.name: anime_control
tools.description: Pause, unpause, seek or stop ONLY a player session launched by this plugin.

session_id.description: Playback session ID returned by anime_play or anime_resume.

tools.name: anime_history
tools.description: List this Hermes profile's observed anime playback progress. Does not read ani-cli or another player's history.

tools.name: anime_resume
tools.description: Continue watching on the Hermes host in local mpv, resolving fresh media links. Advances to the next episode only after a recorded natural completion; otherwise resumes five seconds before the saved position. Only use when the user asks to continue playback.

identifier.description: Exact title/season ID returned by anime_search.
